_comment_dataset_path: data/b05factory/dpo/pairs.jsonl is what data/release/reassemble.sh actually writes; the earlier data/dpo/pairs.jsonl was produced by nothing in this repo and made a direct launcher call fail at startup.
_comment_save_total_limit: Stated explicitly rather than inherited, matching midtrain and sft: the Trainer rotates the previous checkpoint out AROUND each new save, so 1 leaves nothing for latest_checkpoint() to find if the process dies inside that window and the run silently restarts from step 0. Measured on gfx950: one 14B DPO checkpoint is 221 GB (13 fp32 shards + optimizer.bin + pytorch_model_fsdp.bin), so 2 retained means a transient peak of three during rotation -- provision >= 800 GB on the output filesystem.
